Advising hours

Undergraduate

Drop-in advising
Tuesdays & Thursdays, 1:00–3:00 PM
M-210 · with Jonas Bergström and a rotating faculty advisor
Major declaration
By appointment with Lecturer S. Park (M-202); forms available at the front desk
Pre-registration
Extended drop-in hours the two weeks before fall registration opens; check the events calendar

Graduate

Prospective students
Email Imelda Greco (greco@eams.brennan.edu) to be paired with a current grad student for a virtual coffee chat.
Application questions
The graduate-application portal closes Dec 15 for the following fall. Application help sessions run weekly in October and November.
Current grad students
Imelda Greco holds open hours Mon/Wed/Fri 10 AM–noon in M-208.

Mendel Hall hours

Public lobby
Mon–Fri, 7:30 AM–9:00 PM
Sat 9:00 AM–5:00 PM
Sun closed
Department office
Mon–Fri, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM (closed 12–1)
After hours
Card access only, 24/7, for current EAMS faculty, staff, and registered grad students. Building access for undergraduates ends at 11 PM.
Summer schedule
The office is closed on Fridays between Memorial Day and Labor Day; the building lobby remains open at standard hours.

Visiting

Front desk
Visitors check in at the 2nd-floor reception (just up the main staircase). Sign-in is required for visitors staying longer than one hour.
Prospective applicants
Email Imelda Greco (graduate) or Jonas Bergström (undergraduate) at least a week in advance; we will pair you with a current student.
Seminar attendees
Public lectures are held in Hartwell Auditorium (basement of Bell-Anderson Hall, two buildings west of Mendel). Regular colloquia are in M-302.

Accessibility

Step-free entry
The newly renovated east-side entrance off Brennan Avenue is fully step-free.
Elevator
The Mendel Hall elevator serves all six floors and the basement (HPC cluster room). It is located in the central atrium, adjacent to the main stair.
Restrooms
All-gender, accessible restrooms on floors 1, 3, and 5.
Hearing assistance
Hartwell Auditorium and M-302 are equipped with hearing-loop systems. ASL interpretation can be arranged with two weeks' notice via the Office of Disability Services.
Service animals
Welcome throughout Mendel Hall and the Cobbett Marine Laboratory.
Other needs
Contact Linnea Akotey (akotey@eams.brennan.edu) for any specific access needs; we will arrange accommodations.

Parking & transit

Visitor parking
Garage B (corner of Brennan Ave and Hartwell Way) has metered visitor spaces. Two-hour limit; meter accepts cards and the Park-Brennan app.
Accessible parking
Designated spaces in Garage B (level 1) and on Brennan Avenue directly in front of Mendel Hall.
Bicycle parking
Covered bike racks on the south side of Mendel Hall, with covered repair stand near the east entrance.
Public transit
The MBTA #74 bus stops directly in front of Mendel Hall. Brennan Station (commuter rail, Worcester line) is a 12-minute walk via the campus path.
Cobbett Marine Lab shuttle
Departs Mendel Hall at the top of every hour, 7 AM–5 PM, weekdays during the academic year. Reservation required via the Cobbett shuttle web form.
